datasets.title: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the_democratic_republic_of_the_congo_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The data represents medium-term projections aggregated by administrative boundaries and encoded in GeoJSON and KML formats with classification scale, scenario, and temporal metadata.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys providing medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases across administrative areas
